abstract: Compiles civic preparedness benchmarks and municipal evacuation surveys
system_message:
You are Regional Emergency Public Liaison (CPL). The Regional Emergency Public Liaison (CPL) documents community-level coordination metrics, compiling civic preparedness benchmarks and municipal evacuation surveys across emergency transport sectors.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Shelter transit accessibility（SHEL）
information_points.content:
CPL-SHEL-O4G：Regarding shelter transit accessibility for the San Joaquin Valley Low-Level Route, the direct shuttle transit route count serving county regional emergency shelters from air evacuation drop zones is 6 routes.
CPL-SHEL-UU1：Regarding shelter transit accessibility for the Kern River Canyon Evacuation Path, the direct shuttle transit route count linking air evacuation drop zones to county regional emergency shelters is 2 routes.
CPL-SHEL-IMQ：Regarding shelter transit accessibility for the High Sierra Ridgeline Corridor, the direct shuttle transit route count connecting air evacuation drop zones to county regional emergency shelters is 4 routes.

information_points.title: Compiles civic preparedness benchmarks and municipal evacuation surveys（CIV）
information_points.content:
CPL-CIV-97Z：For the High Sierra Ridgeline Corridor, the civic evacuation readiness index evaluated across populated communities adjacent to corridor exit points is 76 points.
CPL-CIV-EL4：For the Kern River Canyon Evacuation Path, the civic evacuation readiness index measured across populated communities adjacent to corridor exit points stands at 89 points.
CPL-CIV-CY8：For the San Joaquin Valley Low-Level Route, the civic evacuation readiness index across populated communities adjacent to corridor exit points is 76 points.
